GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow away. Pushed to recover & raced well back on inside (6L from lead) early . Stayed same until pushed along Two Wide (5L from lead) on home turn. Pressured on rail @ 250m & chased soundly along rail late. # Saved ground/good

Away fairly. Worked fwd Four Wide until raced 3rd 3 Wide No Cover (1.5L from lead) early . Worked to improve 1 length midrace & pushed to quicken Four Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Weakened Five Wide in straight. # Worked & tired
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three-wide and without cover throughout the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 4l off 3 Wide No Cover , pushed Wide turn, Straightened Up 3-4l off all clear, battled on one pace # 3 Wide trip
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early stages and as a result shifted wide and raced without cover from the 1000m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 2 Lengths off 3 Wide No Cover , under pressure turn and dropped out # 3 Wide trip
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover throughout the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Wide went fwd Settled Down Two Wide 2 Lengths home turn 3l swung Wide Straightening Up Middle Of Track re150. Needed run # fitter/peaked
Slow Out 4 Lengths , Settled 2nd last rails 8 Lengths 600m, came widest from the corner and battled on well without getting close # never close
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Trainer was fined the sum of $100 under LR35 for failing to declare a rider by the prescribed time. Bounded on jumping and missed the start.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: jumped Just Ok . Settled Down 3 Wide near last 7 Lengths . widest Straightening Up Ridden Along . Just Held Ground . 1st 2 out 1st 2 home - started $1.40/$2.90 # always well back
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Lost ground at the start when crowded. Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 Lengths , got well back Two Wide 10 Lengths 600m, Ridden Along between runners soon after Straightening Up and only battled # only battled
Jumped Ok sat 3l off, held up turn, Straightened Up 2-3l off all clear, kept on one pace to the line hands and heels # had run/sound

Jumped fairly. Not pushed early & raced 5th Two Wide (2.5L from lead). Held Ground until pushed to quicken Two Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Raced tight Two Wide @ 300m & pressured @ 200m. Chased soundly Two Wide in last 150m. # Every Chance
Jumped Ok , enjoyed good trail Two Wide With Cover behind speed 1 Lengths 800m, off heels to challenge soon after Straightening Up , took over last 200m and held off late challenge to win # brave win
